question: The Extensions tab is 32 lines in ui.rs and loads nothing: it is a placeholder, not an extension host.
probes: Count real extension features in the original's Extensions tab
Implement at least local extension loading, or mark as out of scope
resolution: RESOLVED (wave 20, 2026-11-15): the Extensions tab is no longer a placeholder - it lists the real extension host (Shared.ext_host) with an enable/disable checkbox per extension and the registered hook kinds, logs enable/disable to the event log, and states the Java-jar limitation. WEBPROBE_EXT_TEST=1 loads the built-in ExampleHeaderExtension so the pipeline run is observable in history.
